summary: Narrow, steep lane with houses right against the kerb and parked cars.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room to stand

drivers.seclusion: Large white house hard against the kerb at 3 m; dwellings 8-10 m at the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane, cars parked on it, no verge to pull onto.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street running into a busy main road.
drivers.convention: No sign of overnight parking here.

flags: Noise from the main road at the bottom
sun_shade: Open at the south end; trees overhang the lane from the east.

best_section.where: Gordon Terrace west kerb, beside the white house near Moggill Road
